node.statement: Dependency-bearing bridge for the final substitution: this step depends on nodes 1.5.3 and 1.1.3. Node 1.5.3 gives D <= d. Node 1.1.3 sets D = dist_1(p, C) and d = dist_1(q, C) after applying the minimizer setup to p_j and q. Substituting these two recorded equalities into D <= d gives exactly dist_1(p, C) <= dist_1(q, C).
